tools.name: arrange_elements
tools.description: Move or resize a bounded batch using expected versions, so layout never silently replaces newer geometry.

commandId.description: Stable caller-generated id used for safe retries.

pageId.description: Target Page id. Defaults to the active Page when omitted.

tools.name: create_elements
tools.description: Create a bounded batch of semantic Koi Elements and commit it as one visible, undoable agent action.

commandId.description: Stable caller-generated id used for safe retries.

pageId.description: Target Page id. Defaults to the active Page when omitted.

tools.name: delete_elements
tools.description: Delete a bounded batch by stable id and expected version as one undoable agent action.

commandId.description: Stable caller-generated id used for safe retries.

pageId.description: Target Page id. Defaults to the active Page when omitted.

tools.name: export_document
tools.description: Return the validated portable .koi.json representation of the current Document.

tools.name: get_canvas_context
tools.description: Read the active Koi Document, Page, camera, selection, revision, and sync summary before planning edits.

tools.name: inspect_elements
tools.description: Read bounded previews of up to 32 Koi Elements by stable id, including geometry, version, and semantic properties.

tools.name: list_components
tools.description: List the trusted Astryx components that Koi can place as native HTML/CSS instances.
